title: Three Alpha One Nine
description:
WELCOME THREE ALPHA ONE NINE 

You'll play as 3A19, a specialized robot designed by IMI Energy Solutions to "collect Energy Cells" located throughout time and space. 

OVERVIEW:• 20 Main levels, each with their own unique locale and soundtrack

• 20 Hardcore variations of each level with new aesthetics and a significantly harder difficulty. (You will likely NEVER be able to complete most of these, maybe)

• Hidden "SSD Drives" that reveal the truth about your employer.

• Challenge levels to put your skills to the test

• Customization and ranking system to reward speed, precision, and curiosity 

• ALL FUTURE UPDATES AND CONTENT WILL BE FREE
 

On your adventure you will encounter various enemies and tricky environments that will test your abilities to the limits. You will likely NOT survive your first attempts. 

This is NOT a casual platformer, but this is NOT impossible.

Every second counts, every jump requires precision, and every defeat is just another step towards glory.
 

Are you up for the test?

Good Luck
description_short: A challenging, modern approach to platformers and adventure where speed, precision, and curiosity are not only required, but rewarded. As robot 3A19, jump, run, and boost your way through a wide range of locations throughout time and space.
